name: Education
description: Techlio builds platforms for universities and education providers to manage courses, students and academic operations, with workflow automation and staff dashboards.
h1: Software for universities, *built around academic operations.*
answer: Techlio builds platforms that help education providers manage courses, student records and day-to-day academic work. For Park University we delivered a platform covering course and programme management, student records and enrolment, automated workflows and staff dashboards, from discovery through to support.
problems: Course, student and enrolment information held in separate systems
Routine academic administration done by hand
Staff without a single view of what needs attention

faqs.question: Do you replace an existing student information system?
faqs.answer: Not necessarily. Often the better route is a platform that works alongside what you have and automates the work between systems. We recommend one or the other after reviewing your current setup.

faqs.question: How is student data protected?
faqs.answer: With role-based access, encryption and audit logging designed in from the start, to the requirements your institution sets. Security was part of the Park University build from the first stage.

faqs.question: Can you support the platform after launch?
faqs.answer: Yes. Support is one of the five stages we delivered for Park University, alongside discovery, design, development and deployment.
